assessments.decision: Northwind Labs provides full-time staff with 20 days of paid leave per year under version 3 of the leave policy.
assessments.why: The new decision increases the annual paid leave to 22 days, which conflicts with and explicitly replaces the 20 days specified in version 3 under Northwind Labs leave policy, version 4.

assessments.decision: Northwind Labs does not allow unused paid leave days to carry over to the next year.
assessments.why: The new source states that unused days do not carry over, which restates the existing rule without any conflict or superseding action on carry-over terms.

assessments.decision: All full-time staff receive 30 days of paid leave per year.
assessments.why: Granting 22 days of paid leave per year conflicts with the existing rule providing 30 days of paid leave per year.
